amount.description: Amount of the transfer, in cents. The currency is always EURO.

local_iban.description: Existing IBAN to be used as the destination of the transfer. Can be the main IBAN of an account or a virtual IBAN.

message.description: Message attached to this transfer, visible to all involved parties.

end_to_end_id.description: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the transaction. This identification is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire end-to-end chain. It can be used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the transaction.

counterparty_name.description: Name of the debtor. Allow you to provide the name that will be used for the transaction. If not provided, a default value will be used.

counterparty_iban.description: IBAN of the debtor. Allow you to provide the IBAN that will be used for the transaction. If not provided, a default value will be used.
